name: Working with children checks
what: Ensure staff and volunteers who work with children hold a working with children check from each state where they work, and meet child safety standards.

layers.who: State working with children screening agency
State child safety regulator or commission

basis.quote: Some staff need to meet child safety requirements before they can work with children and young people. For example: pre-employment screening checks , including for tutors, coaches and other instructors
State, territory and federal child safety laws may apply if your business works with children or young people.

issues.what: Each state issues its own working with children check, separate from aged care and NDIS worker checks, so workers in several sectors or states hold several.

evidence.source: Delivering quality care more efficiently: Inquiry report
evidence.quote: A single worker screening check will save care workers - 75% of whom are women - about $88 million a year. This includes the time value of approximately 419,000 hours a year that workers spend on duplicative paperwork.
